Mega City Force - Launch Trailer | PS5 & PS4 Games
https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10013947

Mega City Force, the Retrowave Action Roguelike game, is out now on PlayStation 5 and PlayStation 4! 

Deploy on the streets of Mega City and battle crime solo or with a trusted friend to the electrifying music of artists like Droid Bishop, Timecop1983, and more.
